tools.name: everlist_contract
tools.description: Discovery: the EverList hub manifest - payment mode, fee policy, identity requirements, verticals, and endpoint map. Call this first.

tools.name: everlist_verticals
tools.description: Vertical schema registry: required/optional fields, categories, and booking shape per vertical (events, food, services, jobs, classes, p2p).

tools.name: everlist_search
tools.description: Search the public EverList catalog of bookable listings (events, classes, food, services, jobs, p2p). Free-text q plus optional filters: vertical, category, tags (comma-separated), date window from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), min_price/max_price, sort (date|price|newest). Returns matches with id, title, date,

tools.name: everlist_listing
tools.description: Fetch ONE full listing record by id: title, description, date/time, location, price, escrow payment terms (rail + refund window), capacity and spots left, rating. Use after everlist_search to inspect before everlist_book. Storefront twin: get_product_details (same handler).

tools.name: everlist_book
tools.description: CREATE a booking (or apply+pay for jobs) holding funds in Midnight-blockchain escrow; read status afterward with everlist_booking. Requires a hub token in the X-Hub-Token header on the MCP request (header-only auth; obtain via the hub auth contract: POST /accounts/signup + /accounts/login, keypair s

tools.name: everlist_booking
tools.description: READ the status of ONE booking you created: escrow state (HELD/RELEASED/REFUNDED/...), amount, confirmation code. Naming: everlist_book CREATES, everlist_booking READS - booking_id comes from the everlist_book response. Auth: same X-Hub-Token header as everlist_book. Storefront twin: get_order_statu

tools.name: everlist_bookings
tools.description: LIST YOUR bookings: every booking made with your principal, with escrow state, amount and listing. Use it to find booking_ids before everlist_booking / everlist_cancel. Auth: your usual X-Hub-Token header (book or list token). Principal-scoped: you see only your own.

tools.name: everlist_cancel
tools.description: CANCEL a booking before fulfillment: full refund out of escrow (escrow flips to REFUNDED). Works while escrow is HELD and inside the listing refund window (free/WAIVED bookings cancel too; instant-rail DIRECT bookings have no refund window). Auth for THIS call: THIS booking's cancel_token as the X-H

tools.name: everlist_confirm
tools.description: ORGANIZER action: confirm fulfillment - escrow RELEASES to the organizer (owner_received reports the payout; free/WAIVED bookings confirm too and no money moves). Buyers correctly get a 403 - fulfillment belongs to the listing owner. Auth: your organizer list token as the X-Hub-Token header (or an a

tools.name: everlist_dispute
tools.description: FREEZE a HELD booking for arbitration (DISPUTED): no release and no refund while frozen; if the arbiter vanishes, arbiterTimeoutRefund returns buyer funds after the deadline. Buyer side via MCP: your cancel_token (or book token) as the X-Hub-Token header. Organizer side stays on REST (manage_code ne

tools.name: everlist_rate
tools.description: RATE a settled booking 1-5 (once, buyer-only, owner-immutable). Opens after settlement (escrow RELEASED / WAIVED / DIRECT). Paid reviews are amount-weighted, self-reviews rejected; ratings touch no ledger entries. Auth: your book token as the X-Hub-Token header.

tools.name: everlist_escrow_proof
tools.description: VERIFY-WITHOUT-TRUST: read the escrow straight from the Midnight indexer (dual-source when configured, fail-closed) and get the raw chain projection + verification metadata. No booking details, no identities - only what the chain itself says. Public: no token needed. escrow_id and contract come from

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search EverList listings (events, classes, food, services, jobs, p2p). Returns best matches with price, date, location, and spots left. Storefront-contract alias of everlist_search (same handler) - use whichever family your manifest enabled.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Storefront-contract alias of everlist_listing (same handler): one listing in full - description, date/time, place, price, capacity left, escrow terms (rail + refund window). Inspect before add_to_cart.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: The session draft (at most ONE staged listing). Nothing is booked and no money has moved until the hosted checkout page is completed. Pair: add_to_cart stages, update_cart_item edits quantity, remove_from_cart empties, checkout hands off.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Stage one listing in the session draft (replaces any previous draft: EverList books one listing per booking). Does NOT book. Follow with checkout when the customer is ready.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Change the quantity (1-12) of the staged draft item. EverList carts hold exactly ONE listing, so quantity is the only editable field; get_cart shows the draft. Session-local (TTL 1h) - nothing is booked and no money moves until checkout completes.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Empty the session draft cart (EverList drafts hold at most one listing). Nothing is booked and no money has moved; add_to_cart can stage a different listing afterward.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Stage the hosted booking page for the draft. Returns checkout_url for the customer to open; the rail label states exactly how money moves (or that it is a free/demo booking). No order is placed and no money moves here.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Storefront-contract alias of everlist_booking (same handler): booking and escrow state for the token holder (X-Hub-Token header), including the wallet-less verify URL when an escrow reference exists. Create a booking via everlist_book or the cart flow (add_to_cart -> checkout).

tools.name: search_policies
tools.description: Hub commerce policies: fee policy, payment mode, escrow and refund rules; optionally one listing's terms via listing_id (e.g. refund window before you book).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: everlist_book, get_order_status · Private data: everlist_search, everlist_listing, everlist_book, everlist_booking, everlist_bookings, everlist_cancel, everlist_confirm, everlist_dispute, everlist_rate, everlist_escrow_proof, get_order_status · Public sink: everlist_book · Destructive: remove_from_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: everlist_book, get_order_status · Private data: everlist_search, everlist_listing, everlist_book, everlist_booking, everlist_bookings, everlist_cancel, everlist_confirm, everlist_dispute, everlist_rate, everlist_escrow_proof, get_order_status · Public sink: everlist_book · Destructive: remove_from_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
